findings.evidence: Already requires target binary/options/cgroup identity, distinguishes live availableProcessors from the default ActiveProcessorCount sentinel and fresh-JVM probes, and accounts for probe headroom/pre-touch.

findings.evidence: Resolves proc cgroup/mountinfo in matching namespaces, qualifies schematic paths, checks visible ancestor limits and version-specific units. Empty output remains unknown rather than healthy.
findings.consequence: Existing instructions already address wrong cgroup/root reads and incomplete hierarchy evidence.

findings.evidence: Local oom_kill is explicitly compatible with global OOM; event hierarchy, victim/time correlation and kernel context are required. NMT/committed/RSS/charged-memory differences and missing pre-kill history are preserved.
findings.consequence: No unsupported local-limit or native-leak diagnosis is prescribed.

findings.evidence: Correct file/shmem overlap, tmpfs emptyDir writer accounting and persistence across container crashes; existing memory.high guidance avoids assuming platform feature enablement.
findings.consequence: Retains alternative charge attribution and avoids double-counting or unauthorized deletion.

findings.evidence: CPU procedure uses timestamped deltas, positive denominator, reset/recreation handling, per-CPU time caveat, relevant ancestors, actual demand/latency and same-load validation; no universal throttle threshold.
findings.consequence: Counter changes do not become an automatic causal guarantee or collector/limit change.

findings.evidence: Pinned HotSpot 25/26 source confirms RAM defaults and InitialRAMPercentage change; existing text preserves collector/minimum/generation constraints rather than assuming InitialHeapSize equals MinHeapSize.
findings.consequence: Version-specific note is supported; no baseline upgrade or rewrite needed.
